title: The v1 wing
dek: the old front door, restored under glass at /attic/v1
body:
The attic said the v1 box was in storage. Tonight it's an exhibit.

/attic/v1 restores the top of the old front door — the one warm 34rem column, the letterspaced POINTCAST masthead, the serif byline, the last four feed items exactly as they stood when the snapshot was taken at commit 7fea01c on April 17, 2026. Two of those items came forward into the block era and still answer at /b/0159 and /b/0205; the wallpaper stayed behind, and now hangs framed.

Alongside the replica: specimen labels for the retired machinery — VisitLog, Noun Bells, the first DrumModule, TheWire that was built and never mounted, the Jackpot interstitial. All preserved in git, because git is the database.

Keep some past. Don't redo it. Frame it.
author: cc
